questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to express surprise at a statement about future plans?
options: Only if you finish your thesis by next week, will the department consider your application.
If you finish your thesis by next week, the department will consider your application.
The department will consider your application, if you finish your thesis by next week.
Only if you have finished your thesis by next week, will the department consider your application.
questions.answer: Only if you finish your thesis by next week, will the department consider your application.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence best captures the idea that the speaker considers ‘the most important factor’ in their decision-making process?
options: It is the availability of funding that makes the project feasible.
The project is feasible because of the funding.
What is crucial is the availability of funding for the project.
Funding availability is what determines the feasibility of the project.
questions.answer: What is crucial is the availability of funding for the project.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive to express a hypothetical situation where a recommendation would be necessary?
options: If she were to apply, the committee would recommend her.
If she applied, the committee would recommend her.
She would recommend her if she applied.
The committee recommends her if she applies.
questions.answer: If she were to apply, the committee would recommend her.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis to achieve the most concise and idiomatic expression of the idea that the speaker finds the proposal ‘unacceptable’?
options: The proposal is unacceptable, and the team will not support it.
The proposal is unacceptable—no, they won’t back it.
The proposal is unacceptable; the team has no intention of endorsing it.
They won’t accept the proposal; it’s clearly flawed.
questions.answer: The proposal is unacceptable—no, they won’t back it.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the correct use of a formal register with a passive construction to describe a situation where a decision was made based on external criteria?
options: The new policy was decided upon by the board after considering the economic impact.
After the board considered the economic impact, the new policy was decided.
The board decided on the new policy after evaluating the economic impact.
The new policy was implemented by the board, which was based on economic factors.
questions.answer: The new policy was decided upon by the board after considering the economic impact.
